Can you help us fill orders? We are way behind schedule! Look at the cakes that appear on the TV and make matching cakes. Good luck!

Start your cake here! Look at the order on the TV and choose the right shape for your cake pan.
Use the RIGHT ARROW to move your cake to the next station.
You already have a cake pan! Use the RIGHT ARROW to move your cake to the next station.
You already have batter! Use the RIGHT ARROW to move your cake to the next station.
Try to make a cake that looks exactly like the one on the TV! Comfy Cakes customers are very particular.
Once you have filling, back the cake up to the first station immediately to get your next layer!
You have to put down a cake pan first!

Oh no! Put the filling down on a cake layer!

You didn't match the cake on the TV. The customer is very particular about this order! Try to match the cake.
Very good! You matched the order. Now move your cake to the platform with the star so it can go to shipping.
Need Wax Paper. To keep the line neat, you have to build your cakes on the wax paper! Put cake pans down on the white squares.
Goes back to the main menu
Let's play! Click on the school house to play Purble Pairs. Click the cake factory to play Comfy Cakes. Click the store to play Purble Shop. Click on the red X to exit.
Hello!  Ready to play Purble Pairs?  In this game, you'll need your memory skills. Click on any 2 tiles to turn them over. If the pictures on the tiles match, you have a pair!

Try to remember what pictures are on the tiles you've turned over. That way, when you find a picture you've seen before, you'll be able to find the tile it was on and make a match. Ready? Grrreat! Good luck, Friend!
That's the way to do it! Now find all the pairs!
Now try to find all the pairs before the time meter runs out.
When you match 2 mixer tiles, all tiles on the board are mixed up. If you have a lot of tiles memorized, try to avoid the mixer.
If you can match a tile while the bonus indicator is on it, you earn another Sneak Peek token! You can have up to 3 Sneak Peek tokens.
When you match 2 clock tiles, you get more time on your time meter.
Match the joker tile with any tile on the board.  The other tile's pair will be found for you.
When you match 2 Purble Chef tiles, he will take one of the cakes with him!
When you use a Sneak Peek Token, you'll get a 'peek' at the entire board for a few seconds.
Good job! You finished the first board and collected all the shamrocks. On the next board you must find all the matches and collect the hearts. Keep going!
Excellent work, Friend! You finished the first board and collected all the shamrocks. You'll play 4 boards in Advanced and collect all the hearts, smiley faces and gumdrops! Good luck!
Do you remember how to play Purble Pairs? Turn over tiles until you find 2 pictures that match. Find all matches to win the game. Gooood luck!
Ouch! Sorry! You ran out of time! Try again, won't you?
Oh, no!  You were not fast enough that time. Put your thinking cap on and try again.
You certainly know your way around the schoolhouse. Thanks for playing.
Excellent! You get an A+ that time!
You found all the pairs. You have an excellent memory, Friend.  A+.
To earn more sneak peek tokens, match a tile on the board while it has the Bonus Indicator on it.
The meter on the wall shows how much time you have left. You must find all matches before time runs out.  You can turn off the timer in Options.
When you make matches, the shamrock from the back of the tile goes in the jar. Collect all of the shamrocks to win the board.
When you make matches, the heart from the back of the tile goes in the jar. Collect all of the hearts to win the board.
When you make matches, the smiley face from the back of the tile goes in the jar. Collect all of the smiley faces to win the board.
When you make matches, the gumdrops from the back of the tile goes in the jar. Collect all of the gumdrops to win the board.
This tile has already been matched. Clear the entire board to win.
